name: Kashiwagi Kozue
source:
Takashi meets her on the street while prospecting for a new Botedol. After much hard work she's the only one who takes interest. She's surprised to discover that Botedols are pregnant idols but isn't against the idea. She simply needs to become pregnant very quickly or her new career will be over before it starts.

She loves movies and her favorite food is cake.
